captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a WR-28 microwave waveguide flange with a very short waveguide section. It features a thick square base plate with chamfered corners and four cylindrical mounting holes near each corner. A raised rectangular collar or waveguide section projects from the center, containing a matching hollow rectangular aperture that passes completely through the flange.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric microwave waveguide flange in OpenSCAD based on standard WR dimensions. The script should use a lookup table to configure dimensions for WR codes (such as WR28), allowing customizable wall thickness, flange thickness, and mounting hole parameters.
captions.factory: The flange is created by intersecting a central cube with a 45-degree rotated cube to chamfer the corners, then subtracting a central rectangular opening and four cylindrical mounting holes using the difference() operator. The short waveguide collar is built by subtracting an inner cube from a slightly larger outer cube, positioned and aligned with the central aperture of the flange base.
